source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Under [Transports](vsdata:core-rule/transports), in a **unified force** a unit or model of one army can embark in, or start the battle embarked in, a **TRANSPORT** model in the other army, if it could normally embark in that **TRANSPORT**.

detail.permission: embark in, or start the battle embarked in, a TRANSPORT model from the other army
detail.restrictions: the unit must normally be able to embark in that TRANSPORT
